data.name: Combat Skill
data.description: The vigilante gains any one combat feat as a bonus feat. He must meet the prerequisites for this feat, but he is treated as though he had a number of fighter levels equal to half his vigilante level for the purpose of qualifying for this feat. He can select this talent more than once; each time he must select a different feat.
